sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Jev is a proprietary artificial intelligence model developed by TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco-based company founded in 2024. It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC.
